heading: Twelve years *in production.*
intro: Six roles, newest first. Each year marks when the role began.

items.title: Senior Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer
items.detail: deployed at Monetary Authority of Singapore
items.text: Architected [PathFin.ai](https://pathfin.ai/), a financial AI platform with a RAG chatbot in production, and a two-portal CBDC issuance platform on Hyperledger Besu that passed the client's security audits.

items.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
items.text: Built real-time POS transaction microservices on Java, Quarkus, Spring Boot and Kafka, and led the SAP-to-Fuel/POS integration platform as Technical Lead.

items.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
items.text: Delivered the Large Corporate Loan Approval platform end to end: two Spring Boot microservices, two React micro-frontends and Kafka integration with downstream banking systems.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer
items.text: Designed microservices and GraphQL APIs on Spring Boot and AWS, automated releases across Jenkins and Azure DevOps, and added AI-assisted analytics to operational monitoring.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.text: Built Kafka, AWS and Redis microservices for anomaly detection in reconciliation data, led architecture upgrades with Spring Batch, and supported the move of batch jobs to AWS.

items.title: Software Engineer / Java Developer
items.text: Delivered core Java modules, designed and optimised SQL schemas and queries, and supported production applications.
